info.title: hostingaffe
info.description: The HTTP surface of one hostingaffe instance. Every instance is at its own address; everything but GET /version takes `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

get.summary: The version of this instance.
The caller: identity, role, owner and the token it came in under.

post.summary: Confirm and apply a pending email change.

get.summary: Every project, optionally including deleted projects. Administrators only.

post.summary: Invite a user by email. Administrators only.

get.summary: Every user. Not paginated: the list is people.

post.summary: Replace and resend an invited user's invitation, by name or id. Administrators only.
Deactivate a user, by name or id, and suspend every way they authenticate. Administrators only.
Reactivate a deactivated user, by name or id. Administrators only.

patch.summary: Grant or revoke the administrator role, by name or id. Administrators only.

post.summary: Send confirmation to a user's new email address.
Create an agent and its one token, shown once. Users only.

get.summary: Every agent with its owner and its token, revoked ones included.

patch.summary: Rename an agent, by name or id. Its owner or an administrator.

delete.summary: Revoke an agent's token, by name or id. The identity stays. Its owner or an administrator.

patch.summary: Report the caller agent's stable metadata. An omitted field stays; null clears it.

get.summary: The caller's own user tokens, revoked ones included.

post.summary: A further user token for the caller, shown once.

delete.summary: Revoke one of the caller's own tokens.

post.summary: Create a project with its key and the `kind` label group. Users only.

get.summary: Every project the caller sees. Not paginated.
One project by key.

patch.summary: Change the name, the switches or the instructions page. Users only; the key is immutable.

delete.summary: Soft-delete the project with everything in it. Administrators only.

post.summary: Bring a deleted project back, with everything in it. Administrators only.

get.summary: Assigned users. Assigned users and administrators only.

put.summary: Grant project access to a user. Administrators only.

delete.summary: Remove a user's project access. Administrators only.

get.summary: What the caller would be handed, in that order — the ready-for-agents list — and why the rest is not on it.

post.summary: Take the highest-ranked workable issue and claim it for the caller, in one transaction. 200 with `issue: null` when nothing is workable.

get.summary: What only a human can resolve: questions, review, unready under triage, then stuck blocker chains.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the last page; with wait, return when that page changes.

get.summary: Every label of the project with its group and description. Not paginated.

post.summary: Create a label, optionally in a group, optionally with one line saying what it means.

patch.summary: Rename, regroup or describe a label. A group change that would leave an issue or an epic with two of one group is refused, and `issues` and `epics` say which.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a label; it vanishes from every issue until restored.

post.summary: Bring a deleted label back, with its attachments.
Create one or several wired-up issues in one transaction: all of them or none.

get.summary: A page of slim issues, filtered and sorted; `status` and `label` repeat.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The derived status; repeat the parameter for several.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: A label the issue carries; repeat the parameter for several, all of which it must carry.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: The ETag of the last page; with wait, return when that page changes.

ETag.description: Validator for this page of issues.
Validator for this page of issues.

patch.summary: Apply the same change to up to 100 issues in one transaction: all of them or none.

delete.summary: Soft-delete up to 100 issues in one transaction: all of them or none.

get.summary: The complete issue: the context package.

patch.summary: Change the fields present; `null` clears. `If-Match` with the `updated_at` last read guards the write.

delete.summary: Soft-delete: invisible everywhere, restorable for the grace period; the claim is let go.

post.summary: Back into whatever state it was in, without its claim.
Claim: taken when unclaimed or expired, extended when held by the caller, `claim-held` otherwise unless `force`.
Let go: the claim is cleared and the status is todo. The holder, or a user.
Close as done or canceled. An agent's close lands in review where review is required; a user's lands where it says.
Hand in explicitly, whatever the switch says. Clears the claim; no closed_at.
Back to todo from review, done or canceled; the comment is written first and expected on the way back from review.
Add one label, replacing another of its group.
Add a blocker, across projects if need be; `cycle` when it would close one.
A note that forces nobody to act. On any issue, by anyone, claimed or not.
Ask: what somebody needs to know before the work can go on. Does not release the claim.

get.summary: Every change to the issue, oldest first: who, when, which field, from what to what.

patch.summary: Rewrite a comment. Its author only; the correction is visible as `edited_at`.

delete.summary: Take a comment away for good. Its author, or any user on anybody's; an agent only its own.

get.summary: Questions across the project with their issue, oldest first; open ones by default.
One question; with wait, return when it is answered or the deadline passes.

post.summary: Answer an open question; a second answer is refused.
Create an epic: a theme several issues will hang under, with the plan as its description.

get.summary: A page of slim epics with their progress, newest first; open ones by default.
The complete epic: the living document, the author, the labels, the progress.

patch.summary: Change the title, the description or the labels; `If-Match` with the `updated_at` last read guards the living document.

delete.summary: Soft-delete an epic nothing references; `has-issues` while issues do.

post.summary: Close the epic, whatever is still open; it gates nothing, and the answer carries the progress.
Back to open.
Bring a deleted epic back.

get.summary: Every page of the project as a slim PageSummary, by slug, without the bodies. `q` is the full-text filter over title and body; not paginated, and `label` repeats.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: A label the page carries; repeat the parameter for several, all of which it must carry.

post.summary: Create a page: the slug is given, never derived from the title.

get.summary: The complete page: the Markdown, the author, who touched it last, the labels.

patch.summary: Change the title, the Markdown, the labels or the slug; `If-Match` with the `updated_at` last read guards the document. A rename leaves nothing behind at the old slug.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a page; its slug stays spent until the purge, so a restore can never land on a taken name.

post.summary: Bring a deleted page back, under the slug it kept.

get.summary: Every release of the project: the open one first, then published ones newest first.
One release with the issues that shipped in it.

patch.summary: Annotate the release notes, and correct the name of the newest publication. A field left out is left alone.

post.summary: Name and freeze the open release, then create the next open one.
Take the newest publication back: the release is the open one again and the empty open release goes. Refused once another followed it.

put.summary: Put an issue into the open release by hand. A published release is a record and takes none.

delete.summary: Take an issue out of the open release: it has not shipped yet and does not belong.

get.summary: Whether transactional email is configured, without credentials.

post.summary: Send a transactional-email test message. Administrators only.
